data.name: Joel
data.gender_notes: Joel is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Joel comes from the Hebrew word ‘Yoel’, which means ‘God is with us’ or ‘May God be with us’. It is also derived from the Hebrew verb ‘yadal’ which means ‘to pour out, to pour forth’. In the Old Testament, Joel was a prophet who warned of a coming Day of the Lord and called for repentance. The name Joel carries the meaning “God is with us” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Joel usually hope their child will grow to embody god is with us and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing God's presence and protection.
data.etymology: Joel belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God is with us.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Joel total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.name: יוואל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם יואל הוא שילוב של שני שמות עבריים - יהוה (אלוהים) והואל (תחינה או ישועה). הוא מופיע בתנ"ך כדמות היסטורית וככינוי לאלוהים. יואל הוא נביא שפעל ביהודה בתקופת המלכים, והוא ידוע בנבואותיו על יום הדין ועל חזרתו של אלוהים לעמו.

in_greek.name: Ιωήλ
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ιωήλ είναι η ελληνική μορφή του εβραϊκού ονόματος יואל (Yō'ēl). Στη Βίβλο, ο Ιωήλ είναι ένας από τους δώδεκα μικρούς προφήτες και το βιβλίο του προφητεύει την ημέρα του Κυρίου και την αποκατάσταση του λαού του Θεού.

in_latin.name: Joel
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Joel derivatur ex hebraeo יואל (Yō'ēl), quod significat 'Dominus Deus' vel 'Salus Domini'. In Ecclesia primitiva, Joel fuit propheta qui praedixit diem Domini et restaurationem populi Dei.

in_english.name: Joel
in_english.meaning: God is Lord, Salvation of God, or Yahweh is God
in_english.long_meaning: The name Joel originates from the Hebrew יואל (Yō'ēl), meaning 'God is Lord' or 'Salvation of God'. In the Bible, Joel is a prophet whose book is part of the Twelve Minor Prophets. He prophesied about the Day of the Lord and the restoration of God's people. Historically, the name has been used across Christian cultures, symbolizing spiritual leadership and divine guidance.

data.cultural_impact: The name Joel has a rich cultural history and is rooted in Jewish tradition. In the Old Testament, Joel was a revered prophet whose prophecies spoke of the power and wrath of God. This biblical significance has persisted through the centuries, shaping the way this name is perceived in various cultures. For example, in the Catholic tradition, St. Joel is regarded as the patron saint of farmers and those in the agricultural industry, reflecting the name's origin as a reminder that God is with us in our daily lives.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Joel is rooted in its etymology, which means 'God is with us'. It is a powerful reminder of the presence of God in our lives, and a call to draw strength and comfort from that connection. The name also has a sacred link to the biblical prophet, who warned of the coming apocalypse and called for repentance. This can serve as a reminder for Christians to stay connected to their faith and to live a life that is pleasing to God. Additionally, the second meaning of Joel - to pour out or pour forth - can be seen as a call to be generous and compassionate, sharing God's love and blessings with others.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Joel means "God is Jehovah," symbolizing the prophet's unwavering devotion to God and his mission to call the people back to repentance and restore their relationship with the Almighty.

biblical_reference.note: The book of Joel is one of the twelve minor prophets in the Old Testament.

historical_references.reference: Joel was a prophet active during the Southern Kingdom of Judah's darkest period, when the Assyrian empire had taken control. He delivered his prophecies between 835 and 805 BCE.

According to Jewish tradition, Joel wrote the Book of Joel, a prophetic text in the Hebrew Bible, that describes the coming of the Day of the Lord with cosmic upheaval and the subsequent restoration of Israel.
historical_references.time_period: Unknown post-exilic period, possibly between the 5th and 3rd centuries BCE

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Joel, derived from the Hebrew word 'יואֵל' meaning 'God is Jehovah', has gained modern significance in various contexts. It is commonly found in social media platforms such as Twitter, Facebook, and Instagram, where people use the name as a personal identifier. In the entertainment industry, Joel has been the name of several notable individuals, including Joel Coen (co-founder of the Coen Brothers film production company) and Joel McHale (an American actor, writer, and producer). In religious communities, the name Joel is associated with the Old Testament prophet Joel, whose prophecies are believed to have foretold the coming of the Messiah and the Last Days. The name has also become popular due to its association with Biblical prophecy and weather forecasting, as well as pop culture references.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted Christian named Mary Joel in Dublin, Ireland credits much of their spiritual journey to their name Joel, which means "God is with us". They believe their name has been a blessing and reminder of God's presence in their life.
